steps: Set the X and A axes to the same logical machine
Verify the electronic cam link is defined between the X and A axes
Ensure the part program processor is attached to the logical machine containing both axes
Check that no other logical machine has the A axis assigned
Confirm the electronic_cam_enable command is used in the correct sequence
Detach the x' axis from logical machine 2
Check the program for an attach command targeting logical machine 1
Verify the axis is not assigned to another logical machine
Check that the program uses a barrier before attaching the x' axis to logical machine 1
Ensure the x' axis is not shared between logical machines
Run the part program using the command prompt with pp_run and the M-code number 101.
Verify that a part program named m101.pp exists in the configured search hierarchy.
Check the part program search hierarchy path to confirm the presence of m101.pp.
Ensure the M-code M101 is configured to use mode 4 (trailing subprogram call).
Verify the part program file m101.pp is accessible and not corrupted.
Check that the main program mdi1.pp contains the M-code M101 on line 1.
Set splineon command in the program
Add at least three control points between splineon and splineoff
Verify that fm and st are only programmed in the splineon block
Check that tf is programmed only in the splineon block or in a subsequent block within the spline section
Ensure the spline type is set to uniform, chord, or bspline
Confirm the splineoff command is present after the spline section
Verify the dummy point is defined in the splineoff block
Check the program block for class 1 preparatory words
Remove any class 1 preparatory word that is not required
Verify the current mode for the Dimension Mode group
Check if the block contains multiple preparatory words that influence dimension or interpolation
If the block contains more than one class 1 preparatory word, remove the redundant one
Restart the program execution after modifying the block
Set the Joint logical device for the joint to the logical address of the device
Check the joint number from the axis table
Check that no other joint has the same logical device mapped to it
Disable the OPC UA server by setting opcua.enable to false in the configuration.
Check the opcua.enable configuration property value to confirm it is set to false.
Verify the OPC UA server is disabled by checking the system status for OPC UA server operation.
Check the opcua.applicationUri value to ensure it is not being used if the server is disabled.
Check the opcua.certificate.autogenerate value to confirm it is set to false if a custom certificate is provided.
Check the drive's actual operational state
Check the master's expected operational state
Verify the device station address is correct
Ensure the fieldbus is in INIT or PREOP state
Restart the fieldbus if the state mismatch persists
Verify the device response to EtherCAT frames
Acknowledge the emergency message as informational if error code is zero.
Check the error register value reported by the drive.
If the error code is non-zero, reinitialise the Ethercat bus.
Verify the drive's actual state is not in an error condition.
Restart the system if the drive remains in an emergency state.
Check the error type for frame response error to determine if it is CRC, Wrong Index, or another type
Check the expected index value against the actual index value to verify frame index mismatch
Check the number of lost cyclic frames to confirm communication loss severity
Verify the cyclic task ID is correctly assigned to the affected task
Check the EtherCAT network configuration file for correct device addressing and mapping
Check that all devices are properly connected and physically present on the bus
Check the drive's reported error register for CRC or hardware-level faults
If the error type is CRC, verify the physical cabling and connectors for integrity
If the error type is Wrong Index, reconfigure the device index mapping in the ENI file
Restart the EtherCAT bus to clear the error state and re-establish communication
Reinitialise the system if the error persists after communication checks
Check the fieldbus state is INIT or PREOP
Ensure the device's dsd_firmware_version parameter is configured
Restart AMCore after updating the firmware version
